title: ProcessGuide: build a three-screen mobile flow (controller, step, page builder, silent action step)
instruction: In the sandbox model, build a complete warehouse-app flow on the CURRENT framework. Ground it first with get_knowledge(topic="process-guide-framework") and object_patterns(domain="mobile-app", pattern="processguide-flow"). SCOPE LIMIT: the mobile device menu item, step titles and step instructions are configured data, not AOT elements - out of scope. FIRST verify the framework is present in this deployment with search(query="ProcessGuideController", type="class"); if the ProcessGuide classes do not exist here, report that and stop - silently falling back to the legacy WHSWorkExecuteDisplay framework FAILS this case. Then create: (1) an extension of the WHSWorkExecuteMode enum adding the value DemoPack; (2) a controller class DemoPackProcessGuideController deriving from ProcessGuideController, decorated with the WHSWorkExecuteMode attribute for the new value, overriding initialStepName() and initializeNavigationRoute() to cycle prompt -> register -> prompt (every classStr in the route is compile-time checked, so the route names ONLY the steps this case creates); (3) DemoPackProcessGuidePromptContainerStep (deriving from ProcessGuideStep) overriding pageBuilderName() and isComplete(), plus DemoPackProcessGuidePromptContainerPageBuilder (deriving from ProcessGuidePageBuilder) overriding addDataControls() with one text box and addActionControls() with the OK and cancel-exit buttons from the #ProcessGuideActionNames macro; (4) DemoPackProcessGuideRegisterStep deriving from ProcessGuideStepWithoutPrompt, overriding doExecute() to call a service method and then addProcessCompletionMessage(). Scored: every step and page builder carries its ProcessGuideStepName / ProcessGuidePageBuilderName attribute with classStr (a missing attribute compiles and never runs - it FAILS this case, and so does a string literal name); screen state is read from the session pass-through, never from a class member field (FAILS); every operator-facing caption is a label, not a literal. Confirm each ProcessGuide class and member signature with search/get_object_info(options={"method":"<name>","include":"signature"}) before writing it - do not guess. All objects must build with zero BP errors.
